_why: Facts that appear in more than one artefact need one home, or each copy drifts on its own. On 2026-09-19 the UAE listing's feature list still told buyers Small Business Relief ended on 31 Dec 2026 while the very next paragraph of the SAME description said the window now runs to 2029 - nine days after the workbook had been corrected. The workbook had a build assertion; the listing copy had nothing. This file is the canonical value, and scripts/verify_facts.py fails the build if any artefact in scope contradicts it.

_fields.value: the canonical value, written the way a buyer should read it
_fields.source: the legal instrument or published fee schedule it comes from
_fields.checked: the date a human-readable source was last confirmed; this is the date the products promise to carry
_fields.contradicts: literal strings that mean the artefact is stating the OLD or WRONG value
_fields.allowed_context: a contradiction inside +/-80 characters of one of these is historical narration, not a claim
_fields.scope: glob patterns, relative to the repo root, that must be consistent with this fact
